pr_title: lightning: make OpLevelOptional suppress the error of DoChecksum
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #45382 

Problem Summary:

lightning still fail at checksum stage when set `checksum = "optional"`.

### What is changed and how it works?

Make `OpLevelOptional` suppress the error of `DoChecksum`.

Since the needed integration test is quite simple, I added it into existing integration test `lightning_routes`.

issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

set `checksum = "optional"` in configuration file, and checksum meets error [tikv:9005]Region is unavailable

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

lightning import task is passed

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

lightning import task is failed

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
comments:
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/7b1cf3bfb1a459ea7eb551892a75030b91776341/br/pkg/lightning/importer/table_import.go#L1036-L1047

We should let OpLevelOptional suppress the error of DoChecksum as well

review_comments: `remoteChecksum` should also set to nil. In order to mimic a function returning error, we should handle all the return values. Then you will notice a bug.
